(Japanese: I Can't Choose, Eievui) is a Pokémon manga written by Saji Komori and illustrated by Nishiki Suzumori. It was published on Poké Times in celebration of Eevee Day, from November 21 to December 10, 2024, with two alternate endings published on January 21, 2025. It tells the story of and his .

The final chapter was determined by the readers, with the number of reposts from the second, third, and fourth chapters defining what path Riku would follow and what Eeveelution his Eevee would evolve into.

==Chapters==
 

==Campaign==
A campaign to win a limited physical volume of the manga was held from November 21 at 8:00 PM to December 10, 2024 at 11:59 PM JST. To participate, people would have to follow Poké Times and repost all posts related to the campaign. 100 people who met the criteria were randomly selected. 

Winners were notified via direct message on X (Twitter) on December 20, 2024 and had until December 27, 2024 at 11:59 PM JST to fill in a form with contact information and prize delivery address. Winners began to receive their prize around January 28, 2025.
